# Plinthos

> AI-powered ESG compliance documentation for UK real estate funds and chartered surveyors. Founded by Dr Yishuang (Sherry) Xu, based on analysis of 136 UK REIT sustainability reports scored on a 120-point Disclosure Quality Index.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://plinthos.io/): Plinthos platform overview — AI-generated ESG reports for real estate funds covering GRESB, SFDR, TCFD, and EU Taxonomy compliance.
- [Plinthos for Valuers](https://plinthos.io/valuers): RICS 4th Edition-compliant ESG valuation inserts for chartered surveyors — EPC/MEES risk classification, CRREM misalignment year, capex estimates, and KPI dashboards in under 10 minutes.
- [ESG Playbook](https://plinthos.io/playbook.html): Step-by-step guide to ESG compliance for UK real estate, from regulatory mapping through implementation.
- [Playbook Guide](https://plinthos.io/playbook/guide.html): Detailed walkthrough of the Plinthos ESG implementation methodology.
- [White Paper](https://plinthos.io/whitepaper.html): Full research paper — 136 UK REIT sustainability reports analysed on a 120-point framework revealing a 53-point gap between best and worst reporters.
- [Plinthos DQI](https://plinthos.io/dqi/): The Plinthos Disclosure Quality Index — a 120-point framework for scoring ESG reporting quality across 10 dimensions.
- [What Is the Plinthos DQI?](https://plinthos.io/what-is-plinthos-dqi.html): Explainer of the DQI methodology, scoring dimensions, and how it benchmarks UK REITs.

## RICS & Valuation

- [RICS 4th Edition ESG Requirements](https://plinthos.io/rics-4th-edition-esg-requirements.html): What the RICS Valuation Global Standards 4th Edition (effective 30 April 2026) requires for ESG in Red Book valuations — four core requirements and proportionate compliance.
- [RICS 4th Edition ESG Checklist](https://plinthos.io/rics-4th-edition-esg-checklist.html): Practical checklist for chartered surveyors implementing RICS 4th Edition ESG requirements.
- [RICS 4th Edition at 100 Days](https://plinthos.io/rics-4th-edition-100-days.html): Assessment of compliance patterns 100 days after the RICS 4th Edition took effect — structured workflows vs manual approaches, bank panel expectations.
- [ESG Valuation Insert Template](https://plinthos.io/esg-valuation-insert-template.html): What an ESG valuation insert should contain — four modules (EPC/MEES, stranded asset timeline, capex, KPI dashboard) and how AI tools replace separate QS instructions.
- [ESG Commentary in Red Book Valuations](https://plinthos.io/esg-commentary-red-book-valuation.html): How to write defensible ESG commentary in Red Book valuation reports.
- [ESG Data Sources for Chartered Surveyors](https://plinthos.io/esg-data-sources-chartered-surveyors.html): Where surveyors find ESG data — EPC registers, CRREM pathways, flood risk, and how to assess data quality.
- [Bank Climate Risk Valuation Data](https://plinthos.io/bank-climate-risk-valuation-data.html): Why UK banks require climate risk data in secured lending valuations — PRA expectations, what to provide, and the demand chain from regulator to valuation.

## CRREM & Stranded Assets

- [CRREM Misalignment Calculation](https://plinthos.io/crrem-misalignment-calculation.html): How to calculate a building's CRREM misalignment year — the point when its energy/carbon trajectory crosses the 1.5C pathway.
- [CRREM Excel Tool Retired July 2026](https://plinthos.io/crrem-excel-tool-retired-july-2026.html): What happened after the CRREM Excel tool was permanently retired — alternatives, Licence Partner platforms, and free browser-based tools.
- [Stranded Asset Risk UK Office](https://plinthos.io/stranded-asset-risk-uk-office.html): How to assess stranded asset risk for UK office buildings without instructing a quantity surveyor.

## ESG Reporting & Cost

- [ESG Reporting Cost UK Real Estate](https://plinthos.io/esg-reporting-cost-uk-real-estate.html): ESG reporting costs £15K-£150K/year for UK real estate funds — full breakdown of where the money goes and how AI tools reduce cost by 80-90%.
- [AI vs Traditional ESG Consulting](https://plinthos.io/ai-vs-traditional-esg-consulting.html): Decision framework — when to use a consultant (strategy), when to use AI (documentation), and the hybrid model most funds are adopting.
- [Consultant vs AI ESG Cost](https://plinthos.io/consultant-vs-ai-esg-cost.html): Direct cost comparison between traditional ESG consultancy and AI-powered alternatives for UK real estate.
- [Cheapest RICS ESG Data](https://plinthos.io/cheapest-rics-esg-data.html): Cost-effective approaches to sourcing ESG data for RICS-compliant valuations.
- [AI ESG Reporting Tool Real Estate](https://plinthos.io/ai-esg-reporting-tool-real-estate.html): How AI-powered ESG reporting tools work for real estate — capabilities, limitations, and what to look for.
- [AI ESG Consulting Services UK Real Estate](https://plinthos.io/ai-esg-consulting-services-uk-real-estate.html): AI ESG consulting services for UK real estate cost 80-90% less than traditional advisory — what AI handles, what needs a human, pricing, and how to evaluate providers.

## Regulation & Compliance

- [MEES 2028 EPC C Commercial Property](https://plinthos.io/mees-2028-epc-c-commercial-property.html): How the projected MEES EPC C threshold by 2028 affects commercial property valuations — enacted vs projected thresholds and financial exposure.
- [MEES Compliance Checklist Commercial Landlords](https://plinthos.io/mees-compliance-checklist-commercial-landlords.html): Three-phase MEES compliance checklist — assess, plan, document — with capex benchmarks and sequencing.
- [GRESB 2026 Submission Lessons](https://plinthos.io/gresb-2026-submission-lessons.html): Lessons from the GRESB 2026 cycle — what separated improvers from stallers and how to prepare for 2027.
- [TCFD Reporting Real Estate](https://plinthos.io/tcfd-reporting-real-estate.html): TCFD reporting requirements for UK real estate — governance, strategy, risk management, and metrics/targets.
- [EU Taxonomy UK Real Estate](https://plinthos.io/eu-taxonomy-uk-real-estate.html): How the EU Taxonomy affects UK real estate funds with European investors or cross-border portfolios.
- [ESG Due Diligence Property Acquisition](https://plinthos.io/esg-due-diligence-property-acquisition.html): ESG due diligence checklist for commercial property acquisitions — what to assess before exchanging.

## Market & Investment

- [Green Premium Brown Discount UK](https://plinthos.io/green-premium-brown-discount-uk.html): Evidence for the green premium and brown discount in UK commercial property — the brown discount is accelerating faster than the green premium.
- [Physical Climate Risk UK Property](https://plinthos.io/physical-climate-risk-uk-property.html): Physical climate risk assessment for UK commercial property — flood, heat stress, subsidence, and insurance implications.
- [Net Zero Pathway Commercial Property](https://plinthos.io/net-zero-pathway-commercial-property.html): How to build a credible net zero pathway for a commercial property portfolio.
- [Business Case Retrofit UK Commercial](https://plinthos.io/business-case-retrofit-uk-commercial.html): The financial case for retrofitting UK commercial buildings — capex benchmarks, green premium capture, and hold-vs-divest analysis.

## Optional
